title: Draw and Retainage Terms Across the Construction Loans Line-up
content:
On Construction Loans, work in place is financed by draws. For each product the terms below fix how many draws may be taken, the smallest draw, how quickly a complete draw request is funded, the share of each approved draw held back as retainage and when that retainage is released, whether lien waivers are required between draws, and to whom the draw is paid.

## Draw terms

| Product | Most draws over the construction period | Smallest draw (except the final draw) | Business days from a complete draw request to funding | Lien waivers for the previous draw's work required before the next draw | Draws paid to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 8 | USD 5000 | 5 | Yes | the borrower and the supplier jointly |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 6 | USD 10000 | 3 | Yes | the contractor |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 6 | USD 10000 | 3 | Yes | the contractor |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 6 | USD 10000 | 5 | Yes | the contractor |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 6 | USD 15000 | 5 | Yes | the borrower and the contractor jointly |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 10 | USD 50000 | 5 | Yes | the contractor |

## Retainage terms

| Product | Share of each approved draw withheld until completion (%) | Calendar days after completion by which retainage is released |
|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | 0 | 0 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | 10 | 30 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | 10 | 30 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | 10 | 30 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | 10 | 35 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | 10 | 45 |

## Definitions

- **Maximum draws** — Most draws over the construction period.
- **Minimum draw** — Smallest draw, USD (except the final draw).
- **Draw processing time** — Business days from a complete draw request to funding.
- **Retainage share** — Share of each approved draw withheld until completion, %.
- **Retainage release period** — Calendar days after completion by which retainage is released, provided final lien waivers are received.
- **Lien waiver required** — Boolean; whether lien waivers for work paid by the previous draw must be received before the next draw.
- **Draw payee** — Who draws are paid to.

## Points of reference

- The Livestock Facility Construction Loan allows the most draws, 10, with the largest minimum, USD 50000; the Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan allows 8 with a USD 5000 minimum.
- The Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan carries a retainage share of 0 percent, so no part of its approved draws is withheld; each of the other five withholds 10 percent.
- The Single-Close and Two-Close Home Construction Loans fund a complete draw request in 3 business days; the others in 5.
